cases.name: Barbara Ann "Barb" McBride-Law
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She attended school in Appleton, MN...Eventually Barb made her home in Lakeville, MN where she worked for Advanced Wireless and devoted 22+ years of service. Barb looked forward to spending time at the camper where she enjoyed cruising on the golf cart, bonfires, and hanging out with her camper friends. She will be remembered for her infectious laugh and smile, beautiful soul, and heart of gold. She will be missed and forever loved by many."
cases.narrative:
On 8/30/2025, she was found dead in a camper at a campground in Mazeppa, MN.

An initial press release from the Wabasha County Sheriff’s Office stated that McBride-Law’s body had no “obvious injury or trauma,” but the newly filed search warrants state that she was found with “large purple bruises” on her upper arm.

The medical examiner who examined McBride-Law’s body also found lacerations inside her mouth, petechiae in the eyes, and outer neck bruising. The examiner was unable to give a cause of death, according to the warrants.
